generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: clean high-end original independent dealership identity for transparent PNG website asset.
Primary request: logo for EXACT name "Fiyafe Cars"—six letters F-I-Y-A-F-E and word "Cars"; no extra words.
Concept: dynamic yet restrained bespoke "F" motif made of two high-precision crossing beams with a small aspirational chevron negative space; distinctly modern Gulf automotive retail, not generic dealership clipart.
Style: meticulous flat vector logo, confident typographic detail, balanced sans serif lettering, strong silhouette.
Palette: rich ink-black with bright-but-controlled deep coral-red accent; no gradients.
Composition: centered horizontal mark plus wordmark with genuine alpha padding; icon legible alone at favicon scale; text readable at 180px width.
Constraints: exact "Fiyafe Cars" spelling, no transliteration/Arabic text, no car illustration, no road swoosh, no box, no watermark, no 3D effect. Independent website design concept, not official.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
Separate compact mark and on-dark/accent variants incomplete
No maintained pack or six-design visual release checks
